Name: Jarena Lee
Summary: African American preacher who, after being told the African Methodist Episcopal Church did not license women, preached anyway and in 1819 became the first woman authorised to preach in that church, travelling thousands of miles as an itinerant evangelist.
Contribution: Preached and wrote as a leading voice of the First Great Awakening's second generation, and her published narrative became a founding text of African American women's preaching.
KeyWorks: The Life and Religious Experience of Jarena Lee
Testimony: She testified that God had called her to preach and that no church rule could silence a divine call.
